title: Amazingly Aromatic Uruguayan Rice Pilaf
description: A charred, shaggy, quick-fix Uruguayan dish featuring jasmine rice and a mother-sauce-base, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the jasmine rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is coated with the tomato paste mixture.
Add the vegetable broth, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
